    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]

            bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)

source='''def transform(grid):
    # The grid is divided by full separator rows and columns. Mark a tile
    # with 1 exactly when it contains two foreground cells.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_colors = [grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    common = set(row_colors) & set(col_colors)
    sep_color = max(common, key=lambda v: row_colors.count(v) + col_colors.count(v))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep_color for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
            line.append(1 if sum(v != bg for v in cells) == 2 else bg)
